format: NDCA Sanctioned events, original marking sheets

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Only the Chairman of Adjudicators and the Scrutineer have direct access to the original copies of the judges' marking sheets until the end of the competition.

requirement: Original judges' marking sheets (ballots) stay restricted to the Chairman and Scrutineer until the end of the competition; published scrutineer sheets (OD22-NDCA-0001) are a separate, tabulated artifact produced from authorized scoring records, never by exposing restricted ballots.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: The text treats 'original copies of the judges' marking sheets' (III.D.16) and 'digital copies of the scrutineer sheets' (III.D.17) as different items but does not define 'scrutineer sheets'. The book also uses 'blank scrutineer sheets' (Section III, qualifications list, p.15), 'scrutineering sheets' (Section III, p.14: a copy of the program and scrutineering sheets is submitted after sanctioned events) and 'the scrutineers' marking sheet' (Section IX, p.40, where disqualifications are noted). What a scrutineer sheet contains, whether it shows per-judge marks, and when after a day it may be uploaded relative to finalization are UNRESOLVED. Confidentiality rules also tie to OD-10 (PR 842).
